newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar signs deals to develop two oil fields with three Japanese firms.
- Manufacturing industry accounts for up to 20 percent of Lebanon's revenues.
- Algeria's Islamic Salvation Front leader Madani says no deal with the government behind his release.
- A Saudi investment and trade conference opens in London on Wednesday.
